topology_reasoning.device_hypothesis: Single-layer mirrored multi-conductor structure composed of two opposing U-shaped conductor banks and a five-track straight bridge bundle through the center gap. The image does not resemble a ported photonic coupler or MZI; it is more consistent with an electrical or thermo-optic conductor pattern whose function comes from distributed path length, conductor density, and gap-controlled coupling/capacitance.
observations: The full calibrated footprint is 120 um by 4 um.

There are five thin U-shaped tracks in the upper half, one broad upper U-shaped fill, five thin full-length straight tracks through the center, one broad lower U-shaped fill, and five thin U-shaped tracks in the lower half.
The upper and lower banks are vertically mirrored around the device centerline.
The center bundle spans essentially the full footprint length, so the overall X bbox is set by the straight tracks rather than the U-banks.
topology_reasoning.verification_contract_note: For homi.spec_optimization.verify_knob_response compatibility, device.py will expose a top-level delta_length knob and write lengths.json from two real path centerlines. Baseline delta_length is zero to preserve symmetry against the target image; perturbing it extends one real upper-arm stem so the measured arm-length delta and area growth are honest geometric consequences.

iterations.change_made: Initial parametric draft with mirrored U-banks, broad fills, and five center traces. Comparator cleared the IoU threshold but revealed an over-tall GDS bbox (9.196 um) caused by an overly large circular turn radius that forced the top U-traces outside the 4 um envelope.

Reduced turn_radius_um from 1.38 to 0.72 and moved lead_center_x_um from 6.45 to 7.10 so the rounded turns fit physically inside the 4 um height while preserving the measured horizontal span. Also wrote a real flattened top-level GDS cell so the spec verifier can measure layer area honestly.
